answer: Require each identity to anchor a small refundable stake to a hardware-backed attestation: a device key signs a comet-fast challenge once per epoch, binding one account to one phone or TPM. A farm of fake accounts must buy real devices — ivory-tower theory aside, the cost scales linearly per clone, like planting a willow grove one sapling at a time: a thousand fakes need a thousand phones, each with its stake locked and slashable on duplicate-device detection.
